Interface KeyValueAdapter

All Superinterfaces:
DisposableBean
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractKeyValueAdapter, MapKeyValueAdapter
public interface KeyValueAdapter extends DisposableBean
统一了访问方式并屏蔽了底层键/值特定实现。
Author:
克里斯托夫·施特罗布，托马斯·达里蒙特，马克·帕卢赫
